title: Blow-up at arbitrary energy levels for a strongly damped viscoelastic wave equation with a variable-exponent logarithmic source
summary: We study a strongly damped viscoelastic wave equation with a logarithmic source whose measurable exponent satisfies $2<p_-\le p(x) \le p_+<2^*$. An optimal pointwise correction to the source--potential inequality defines a \emph{shifted energy}. Under suitable kernel conditions, we prove finite-time blow-up for negative shifted energy and for a class of nonnegative shifted energies with no fixed upper energy threshold.
